edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from the untrusted caller msg.sender.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
acceptOwnership promotes the verified newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
TokenBEP20 constructor mints the whole supply to owner.
TokenBEP20 constructor sets _totalSupply.
TokenBEP20 constructor credits balances[owner].
TokenBEP20 constructor sets the symbol state variable.
TokenBEP20 constructor sets the name state variable.
TokenBEP20 constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Initial supply is computed with unchecked multiplication 1000000000 * 10**6 * 10**6.
The _newun parameter is stored into the newun state variable.
transfernewun writes the locked recipient into newun.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the burn adjustment.
balanceOf queries the balance of its tokenOwner parameter.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
msg.sender controls which balance is debited inside transfer.
The to parameter determines the credited recipient in transfer.
The tokens parameter determines the debited amount in transfer.
require(to != newun) gates transfers against the locked address state variable.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
approve writes an allowance keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
The spender parameter is the allowance target in approve.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value set in approve.
approve writes into the allowed nested mapping.
transferFrom consumes the allowance of the untrusted msg.sender.
The from parameter selects the debited account in transferFrom.
The to parameter selects the credited account in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the moved amount in transferFrom.
transferFrom silently assigns newun to the first recipient when newun is still zero.
transferFrom updates balances of from and to.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping of the spender.
The tokenOwner parameter keys the allowance lookup.
The spender parameter keys the allowance lookup.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
approveAndCall grants an allowance for the untrusted msg.sender.
The spender parameter is both the approved address and the external callee.
The tokens parameter is the approved amount passed to the callee.
The data parameter is forwarded to the callee callback.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the attacker-controlled spender contract.
The receiveApproval callback can re-enter token functions such as transferFrom while allowance is live.
onlyOwner restricts clearCNDAO to the untrusted msg.sender matching owner.
The local _owner is initialized from the untrusted msg.sender in clearCNDAO.
clearCNDAO executes a native ether transfer that hands control to the recipient.
The local _owner is the recipient of the ether transfer performed by clearCNDAO.
The payable EthereumApex fallback accumulates the ether balance that clearCNDAO drains.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter exists only to supply the newOwner state write inside transferOwnership.
The _newun parameter is used only by transfernewun to set the newun state variable.
The tokenOwner parameter is a transient lookup key for the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The to parameter only provides the credited address for the transfer function.
The tokens parameter only provides the transferred amount for the transfer function.
The spender parameter is only an allowance key for the approve function.
The tokens parameter is only the allowance value written by approve.
The from parameter is only the debited account key in transferFrom.
The to parameter is only the credited account key in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is only the moved amount in transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is a transient read key for the allowed mapping.
The spender parameter is a transient read key for the allowed mapping.
The spender parameter is the approved address and the target of the external receiveApproval call.
The tokens parameter only supplies the approved amount in approveAndCall.
The data parameter is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
The local _owner is a short-lived alias of msg.sender used only inside clearCNDAO.
